item.title: ‘The Alabama Solution’ Prison Doc Up For An Oscar
item.description: The prison industrial complex in the United States is one that has a murky place in the nation’s conscious. A look inside the nation’s fifth-largest prison system in the state of Alabama and the alleged abuses that have been documented by incarcerated activists is the core of a striking documentary, The Alabama Solution.
